sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Hero will win all the big ones. This effect is magnified if Villain isn’t 3-betting with enough suited aces and suited connectors,

used to raise in spots like this when | first started playing deep stack NL. | could get overcards to fold and still have equity against overpairs. It was profitable. But later | realized that calling is a way better option.

Why raise with a set when | could allow Villain to keep bluffing and/ or value-betting with worse hands? Why semi-bluff the flop when | have little incentive to raise with a set? Why not mimic the action | would take with a set and add credibility to my line?
This is another spot isa used to raise way too much. | could aot
